g.text: If not send heartbeat for 6s -> the broker will
be fenced off cluster by controller
Controller will assign new leader for a Partition
Only one consumer is meant to read from a partition at a time. This is done to ensure message order without needing locks.
stateless and stateful: stateless handle messages isolated, stateful need stream of messages. In Kafka,
Stateless is different from stateful when you have to ask: Does my problem need state, window, join?
Normal Kafka and Kafka streaming don't be different from each other by ability, normal Kafka
can handle realtime data, but need to configure rebalancing and restoring manually, which is supported by
